mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{changeQty}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stock + #{changeQty} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sku, IFNULL(SUM(stock), 0) AS total_stock, IFNULL(SUM(stock < threshold), 0) AS low_stock_count, IFNULL(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS on_shelf_sku_count FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = 0 AND threshold > 0

SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, specs, stock, threshold, GREATEST(threshold - stock, 0) AS suggest_restock, price FROM product_sku WHERE deleted = 0 AND threshold > 0 AND stock < threshold ORDER BY (threshold - stock) DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(change_qty), 0) AS deduct_qty FROM stock_log WHERE change_type = 1 AND created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock - #{qty}, sales = IFNULL(sales, 0) + #{qty}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0 AND stock >= #{qty}
UPDATE product_sku SET stock = stock + #{qty}, sales = GREATEST(IFNULL(sales, 0) - #{qty}, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{skuId} AND deleted = 0
